preview: Jamaica Kingsmen face Barbados Tridents in CPL 2026 Match 4 at Sabina Park. The match is scheduled for Tue 11 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The CPL's newest franchise restores a Jamaica-based men's team, led by a local group featuring Rovman Powell, Andre Russell and Odean Smith. Barbados return to the Tridents identity and national colours in 2026, with Gudakesh Motie, Sherfane Rutherford and Brandon King among the senior Caribbean core. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
